## Flagship Projects

### 1. Altramax Learn — AI-Powered Digital Education Platform
- **Live Platform**: https://learn.altramax.org
- **Android App Download**: https://learn.altramax.org/Altramax-Learn.apk
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Full-Stack Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Gemini AI API, Cloudinary, REST APIs.
- **Summary**: Modern e-learning platform and mobile app featuring dynamic course delivery, video streaming, automated multi-currency payment workflows, and an AI-driven quiz assessment engine powered by Google Gemini that generates adaptive questions and certificates.

### 2. AI Workflow Automation & Document Processing Suite
- **Role**: Lead Developer
- **Tech Stack**: n8n, Claude Code, Gemini AI, Webhooks, Document Processing.
- **Summary**: Practical AI automation suite connecting enterprise tools with everyday workflows. Ingests raw documents, extracts structured data, refines text content, and coordinates multi-channel alerts and publishing with zero manual overhead.

### 3. Responsible AI Evaluation Tool & Framework
- **Role**: Creator & Architect
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript, CSS Design System, Responsive Canvas / Sliders.
- **Summary**: Software companion to *Ethics in Code*. Provides an interactive 5-pillar audit tool (Fairness, Privacy, Transparency, Oversight, Robustness) to dynamically score AI applications and generate Composite Trust Index diagnostics aligned with the European AI Act.

### 4. WordWise AI — WordPress Editorial Assistant Extension
- **Role**: Plugin Developer
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, JavaScript (ES6+), WordPress Hooks API, OpenAI / Gemini API.
- **Summary**: Modular WordPress plugin that brings generative AI directly into the Gutenberg block editor, automating meta description generation, readability scoring, and multilingual content extraction.
